card.name: Separators in subject and heading lists
card.fires_on: Dashes, semicolons and ampersands that separate items in catalog subject headings, keyword lists, or navigation lists. Mostly in web text, rarely in drug labels.

modes.label: Catalog subject dashes
modes.description: Double dash joining parts of a library subject heading.

modes.label: List or menu separators
modes.description: Dash, semicolon or ampersand between entries in link lists or cross-reference lists.

card.plain: It fires on the small dashes and separators that split up entries in heading and keyword lists.
